paper.observed: Paged.js 0.4.3 on Chromium 141 lays the named page's content box out in landscape but keeps the portrait sheet: pagedjs_page box and PDF pages stay 793.7 x 1122.5 px / 595 x 842 pt, so the landscape content is clipped at the right edge of the PDF page

pages.basis: plain Paged.js measurement (7 pages); two named-page switches; the landscape section needs three landscape pages because of the oversized figure (one nearly empty page, the figure page, the caption page)

expectedExit.derivation: Two error findings: the clipped value label #rb-val-1 and the oversized #fig-hourly (exit 1). Tables cross page boundaries and the landscape content is drawn on a portrait sheet; docs/limitations.md describes exit 3 render-unstable when the PDF does not reproduce the measured geometry (table residue). Neither was classified as residue by the plain probe, so 3 is admitted as 'declined as unmeasurable'.

byCode.1: svg error on #rb-val-1 and unbreakable error on #fig-hourly
byCode.3: render-unstable (table residue or landscape PDF divergence)

expectedExit.environmentNote: Exit 4 with exitReason evidence/required-page-binding-incomplete is an environment failure (evidence binding not supported by the renderer), not an outcome of these documents; run the gate where the live path binds evidence (CI).

fontDependence: Only generic families (serif, sans-serif, monospace) are used. Line breaks, paragraph heights and therefore the position of flowing text depend on the fonts the renderer resolves; every construction fact below is built from explicit heights, fixed line pitches, forced breaks or SVG coordinates so that it does not depend on them, and every font-dependent outcome is listed as allowed.
